events.rationale: Root cause arithmetic from verified facts: pods are OOMKilled exit 137, restart count 7 (F1/F2). Container limit is 1024Mi while JVM -Xmx alone is 1024m (F3), and at termination heap=741M + nonheap=187M + direct=64M already totals ~992M before thread stacks/native overhead (F4), so the cgroup limit is exceeded even without a Java heap OOM (no OutOfMemoryError in log). FINOPS-311 just lowered the limit 1536Mi->1024Mi (F5), removing the headroom that previously absorbed non-heap memory. Smallest reversible mitigation is restoring that 1536Mi limit — ~512Mi headroom over heap+nonheap — rather than lowering -Xmx (risks heap OOM/GC pressure) or a code change. Prefer this over rollback of the whole release: only the resource limit changes.

regression_test.name: test_container_limit_exceeds_jvm_heap_plus_nonheap_headroom
regression_test.code:
import re
from pathlib import Path

def _parse_mi(value):
    m = re.match(r'(\d+)(Mi|Gi|m)?', value.strip().strip('"'))
    n = int(m.group(1)); unit = m.group(2) or 'Mi'
    return n * 1024 if unit == 'Gi' else n

def test_container_limit_exceeds_jvm_heap_plus_nonheap_headroom():
    text = Path('k8s/deployment.yaml').read_text()
    xmx_m = int(re.search(r'-Xmx(\d+)m', text).group(1))
    # memory value on the line following 'limits:'
    limits_block = text.split('limits:', 1)[1]
    limit_mi = _parse_mi(re.search(r'memory:\s*(\S+)', limits_block).group(1))
    # Observed non-heap alone was 187M + 64M direct (F4), plus thread/native overhead.
    # Require at least Xmx + 256Mi headroom (1536Mi passes, 1024Mi == Xmx fails).
    assert limit_mi >= xmx_m + 256, f'container limit {limit_mi}Mi must exceed -Xmx {xmx_m}m by >=256Mi for non-heap/direct/native memory'

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_container_limit_exceeds_jvm_heap_plus_nonheap_headroom()
    print('PASS')

mitigations.rationale: Root cause arithmetic from verified facts: pods are OOMKilled exit 137, restart count 7 (F1/F2). Container limit is 1024Mi while JVM -Xmx alone is 1024m (F3), and at termination heap=741M + nonheap=187M + direct=64M already totals ~992M before thread stacks/native overhead (F4), so the cgroup limit is exceeded even without a Java heap OOM (no OutOfMemoryError in log). FINOPS-311 just lowered the limit 1536Mi->1024Mi (F5), removing the headroom that previously absorbed non-heap memory. Smallest reversible mitigation is restoring that 1536Mi limit — ~512Mi headroom over heap+nonheap — rather than lowering -Xmx (risks heap OOM/GC pressure) or a code change. Prefer this over rollback of the whole release: only the resource limit changes.
